verdict.rationale: Square's Terminal API docs confirm tip collection with a separate tip screen and support for custom tip amounts on hardware terminals, directly supporting merchant-configured tipping prompts at checkout. However, evidence lacks detail on configuring specific smart percentage suggestions or a dashboard-level UI for merchant-ops (non-developer) users to set tipping options. missing for 10: dashboard-level UI configuration flow for percentage/smart-tip presets, independent hands-on confirmation of the tipping UX on readers.
